rationale: canvas-kernel: the font registry records each @font-face rule's declared font-weight range (declare_font_face_weight_range, css_match_declared_weight, declared_face_synthesizes_bold, has_declared_font_face_weights), make_paragraph synthesizes bold from that declared range as Chromium does, and match_registered_typeface keeps a declared family on its nearest face instead of returning no match past the weight tolerance. Families registered without declarations behave exactly as before; no API is removed and no authority boundary moves; Pulp-only.
